title: Sausage Links (GV Vermont Maple)
description: Oven or skillet sausage links. Check the package: if it says fully cooked, you are just heating them.
steps: Oven (easy with hash browns): Air Fry mode 400°F, foil-lined sheet pan, 10 to 14 min, turn halfway. Fits on the same rack or pan as the hash browns.
Skillet: medium heat, splash of oil, 10 to 12 min, turning often, until browned all over.
Done: browned and 160°F inside if raw links.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R13
notes: Thrifty told Joe the maple links on his order are uncooked, so cook them all the way through.

not_healthy: Sausage is processed meat high in sodium and saturated fat.
Maple flavored sausage has added sugar.
